title: Twenty-first century films
statementMd:
List titles released in the year 2000 or later.

Expected columns: `title`, `release_year`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT title, release_year FROM movies WHERE release_year >= 2000;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
